_about: 09 review classification. The Google Play public web endpoint (batchexecute UsvDTd, sort = NEWEST) was queried with hl=ko, gl=kr on 2026-10-31 ~10:05 KST. 100 newest reviews per app, Android only, Korean store locale. Only counts and keyword rules are kept here. Review texts are third-party content and stay in a local temp folder.
limits: NOT representative: only users who write reviews, and newest-first sorting overweights recent incidents (e.g. an outage week).

The 100 newest reviews cover very different time windows: Lucky Defense 7 days, Random Dice 2 25 days, Random Dice ~2 months, 궁수키우기 RPG and 아처키우기 ~2 years, CatWar2 ~5 years. Counts are NOT comparable across apps.

Keyword multi-label classifier. A manual read of 32 randomly drawn 1-3 star reviews found 3 clearly wrong labels caused by incidental words (the game name 운빨 -> balance; 못깨 -> balance; 주작 -> liveops). Matchmaking/AFK-partner complaints have no category. Precision was not measured. Use the numbers to rank complaint types inside one app, not as rates.
Developer replies were not analysed. App Store was not sampled.
